ledger: Magician/performer (only character; man in blue suit) | 0:00-3:00 seen only as two hands entering from frame-left, far arm in royal-blue suit sleeve with white shirt cuff, one hand holding a gold coin above the cups; 4:50 face revealed: dark swept-back hair, rectangular glasses, thin mustache with light stubble, royal-blue suit, white shirt, black bow tie over a red necktie, yellow pocket square, gold cuff buttons, seated at round red table, hands on near and far cups | 9:75 same suit, glasses, bow tie + red tie, yellow pocket square, seated in black/wood chair, seen in left-side profile on frame right, one hand lifting a coin over the back cup, other hand flat on table by front cup | Continuous single orbiting/pull-back camera move with no hard cuts; hand/body position and facing stay plausible through the orbit; facial hair grows from thin mustache + light stubble (4:50-5:75) to mustache + chin patch (7:25) to a full dark jaw-line beard (9:00-9:75)

Background bystanders (dark-clothed figures, blurred) | 0:00-3:00 standing figure(s) behind table, 4:50-6:00 seated people at background tables | 7:50-9:75 one dark figure at left wall then one at right behind performer | Positions shift consistently with camera orbit; too blurred to assess identity

findings.description: Within one continuous shot of about 4 seconds, the performer's facial hair changes progressively. At 4:75-5:75 he has a thin mustache with light, patchy stubble. By about 7:00-7:25 a defined chin patch and darker mustache appear. At 8:75-9:75, seen in profile, he has a full, dark, well-defined beard along the jaw and chin. Lighting and angle changes do not explain how much it grows, and no time passes that could account for it.
